reviewed_by: Delegated Task B coding agent: source-semantic review against the live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP view of retail igi.exe (entry 0x004A50F5) and the bound Radare2 artifacts; candidate translation unit recompiled with the repository -O3 flags.
review_basis: The current engine/src/retail/model/iff_chunk_tree.cpp hashes to 69b2e71f88a595c3cfcccf5b40df8c3ca54412b41ff46f09a0585175dc050ace. The retail entry was re-read through the live Binary Ninja view (decompile and block/edge sets) for this review, and the bound Radare2 artifact is unchanged. The candidate object and its linked-image symbol were then compared to that reconstruction. This review supersedes the earlier report that did not use the seven required semantic check names or that described the retail child link offset incorrectly.

candidate_function.summary: IffChunk_GetPayload: returns the payload buffer address, or nullptr when the payload is empty.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail 0x005179C0 (Binary Ninja Terrain_RenderWaterSurface_6) is a one-block leaf that returns the dword at +0x1C, the chunk payload pointer. The candidate IffChunk_GetPayload returns the payload buffer address of the same node.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: Retail signature int32_t(void* arg1): one pointer argument, 32-bit return carrying the payload pointer. Candidate IffChunk_GetPayload(const IffChunkNode*) takes the same one pointer and returns a 32-bit pointer.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: One constant: payload offset +0x1C. No scaling.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: Retail returns the dword stored at +0x1C; the candidate returns the address of its payload buffer. The port holds the payload by value, so the address of the buffer stands in for the retail pointer. For an empty payload the candidate returns nullptr, whereas retail returns whatever dword is stored at +0x1C.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: Neither retail nor candidate makes any call; this is a pure leaf with no memory writes.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Retail always returns the +0x1C dword. The candidate returns nullptr for an empty payload; callers in iff_skeleton.cpp treat null as a malformed chunk and abort the read, which is an added guard rather than a changed success path.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: No floating-point value, constant or comparison appears in the retail function or the candidate.

checks.name: addressability
checks.detail: Present with external linkage (nm type T) at 0x00423880 in build-clean-win32/igi1.exe under the retail catalog name Iff_GetChunkPayload, pinned by the asm-label on the declaration in engine/include/igi/retail/model/iff_chunk_tree.hpp and inherited by the out-of-line definition; 3 direct call site(s) (per caller: AnimIff_LoadAnimationFile x3). The C++ source identifier remains IffChunk_GetPayload.

checks.name: port_only_divergence
checks.detail: Port-only divergence: C++ source identifier IffChunk_GetPayload and typed pointers instead of the retail ABI; the emitted assembler name now matches the retail catalog name, and the compiled body is byte-identical to the pre-change object.

signature_comparison.rationale: Retail returns the raw +0x1C dword as int32_t; the candidate returns a const std::byte*. Both are 32-bit values in EAX under cdecl, and the candidate adds an empty-payload null case.

limitations: The port returns nullptr for an empty payload where retail returns the raw dword at +0x1C.
No live paired retail/candidate game-process capture exists; STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED is the maximum supported status.
The CFG agreement cited is Binary Ninja vs Radare2 on the retail image, not a candidate-vs-retail isomorphism score.

port_only_divergences.detail: retail symbol name Iff_GetChunkPayload equals the candidate emitted symbol Iff_GetChunkPayload; the C++ source identifier IffChunk_GetPayload is pinned with a declaration-level asm-label. Instruction bytes and relocations are unchanged by the label.
empty payload returns nullptr instead of the raw +0x1C dword.

addressability_rebind.change: declaration-level GCC asm-label added to the owning header; no definition, computation, argument, return value or side effect changed
addressability_rebind.note: This rebind re-established the symbol and linked-image address after the assembler-name change. The semantic findings above were not re-derived; they remain bound to implementation SHA-256 69b2e71f88a595c3cfcccf5b40df8c3ca54412b41ff46f09a0585175dc050ace. Addressability is not behavioural evidence.
